description: Search inside scanned US newspapers and browse the Library of Congress catalogue. No API key.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-libraryofcongress

environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so the Library can always reach a human.
environmentVariables.name: LOC_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 6000, floor 3000.
environmentVariables.name: LOC_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one catalogue, record or collection request, in milliseconds. Default 30000.
environmentVariables.name: LOC_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Deadline for one search_newspapers request, in milliseconds. The full-text corpus answers in tens of seconds. Default 90000.
environmentVariables.name: LOC_NEWSPAPER_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: LOC_LOG_LEVEL
